question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Altercation
solution:
The correct answer is **"Agreement"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Altercation- **a noisy argument or disagreement, especially in public.
 
• **Quarrel- **a heated argument or disagreement, typically about a trivial issue and between people who are usually on good terms.
 
• **Agreement- **harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling.
 
• **Controversy- **a** **prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion.
 
• **Argument- **an exchange of diverging or opposite views, typically a heated or angry one
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **Option 2 i.e. Agreement.**
